Do you send people into dangerous work?

They paid my family the day after the accident. I did not even have to ask twice.
Cheap, fast and polite. I sleep better knowing my crew is covered.
My partner was insured with them and they kept every promise they made.
They asked sensible questions and gave me a fair price for a dangerous job.
When you hire people for short and risky contracts you take on a cost that most insurers will not touch.
We specialise in exactly that cost. Our cover follows the contract and ends with it.
Reasonable and flexible premiums that follow the length of the employment contract.
Fair renewal premiums for people who come back to us.
You may cancel a policy whenever the contract ends early.
Claims are settled quickly and without a mountain of forms.
Each time you come to us we look at three things before we set a premium.
The length of the employment contract.
The age and health of the person you hired.
Their training and experience in the field.
When the time comes to renew, we look at the record of the contract so far.
If the work is going well, the renewal premium reflects it.
If you extend the employment contract, the cover can be extended with it.
We accept cancellations once the employment contract has ended.
You can rest assured that a valid claim is paid in full.
Had you hired someone with a clean record, the claim is simple and the money arrives within days.

records: Morning Field
A loose handful of white and yellow field flowers. Cheerful and modest.
Red Promise
A dozen red buds in green paper. For apologies and anniversaries.
Blue Harbour
Blue and white blossoms with silver leaves. Calm and cool.
Sunset Basket
Orange and red flowers in a woven basket that the recipient may keep.
Quiet Garden
Small purple flowers in a clay pot. They last for weeks.
Grand Gesture
A tall arrangement of lilies for the moments that need a statement.
Lemon Bright
Yellow tulips tied with a ribbon. Sunshine in a vase.
Midnight Velvet
Deep red and dark purple blooms. Dramatic and memorable.
Country Lane
Mixed wild flowers with long grass, as if picked on a walk.
Snow Crown
White roses and baby's breath for weddings and farewells.
